description: Opening the model picker on a phone does not focus its search. The screen is 390x844. To "open the model picker": wait for ".header" to be visible; when the window is narrower than 768px, the picker is in the overflow menu: if ".chat-overflow-popover" is not visible, click the button with aria-label exactly "More options", then click the visible ".model-picker.p-select" inside ".chat-overflow-popover"; on a wider window, click the visible ".model-picker.p-select" inside ".status-bar". The element clicked is "the picker"; its panel is ".model-picker-panel". 1. Navigate to /new and open the model picker. 2. The panel's searchbox (role "searchbox") should be visible. 3. It must not be document.activeElement.
